goal.text: Leave the mall safely after the shaking.

intro.text: The shaking stopped. Everyone is leaving the mall.

hint.text: What is the safe way down after an earthquake?

lesson.text: After the shaking, use the stairs and walk out. Wait in an open area.

choices.label: Walk down the stairs and out
choices.feedback: Walk, do not run. Go to the open parking area.

choices.label: Take the elevator down
choices.feedback: Do not use elevators after an earthquake. Use the stairs.

choices.label: Run and push to get out
choices.heading: Not safe yet
choices.feedback: Walk fast, but do not run or push.

choices.label: Wait by the mall wall outside
choices.heading: Not safe yet
choices.feedback: Things can fall from the building. Move to the open area.
